data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(RED test infrastructure — DD ownership belongs to task-2 GREEN impl. This task pins the contract via 15 behavioral test cases collectively covering dd-1..dd-5.)

## Implementation Notes
Mirror tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh (commit be8adce30c). PATH-stub `aws`, `read-config`, and use DSO_CONFIG_FILE env override for test isolation (per bug 3319 — never write to real .claude/dso-config.conf).

### 15 test functions
1. t_happy_path_creates_all_resources — full IAM role → log group → Lambda → Function URL → concurrency flow
2. t_rerun_is_no_op — counter == 0 on second run
3. t_missing_iam_aborts_before_create — simulate-principal-policy implicitDeny → exit 5; zero create-* calls
4. t_sts_get_caller_identity_failure_aborts_before_create — exit 4
5. t_missing_python_runtime_aborts_before_create — lambda list-runtimes excludes python3.13 → exit non-zero
6. t_missing_bucket_name_in_config_aborts_with_exit_6 — review_telemetry.bucket_name absent → exit 6
7. t_iam_policy_scoped_to_bucket_arn_only — captured put-role-policy JSON contains s3:PutObject + bucket ARN only; no s3:*, no Resource:"*"
8. t_iam_role_propagation_retry_with_backoff — create-function fails once with InvalidParameterValue, succeeds on retry; 3 attempts asserted
9. t_log_group_retention_7d — put-retention-policy --retention-in-days 7
10. t_function_url_no_api_gateway — create-function-url-config used; NO apigateway invocations
11. t_reserved_concurrency_set_to_10 — put-function-concurrency --reserved-concurrent-executions 10
12. t_simulate_principal_policy_returns_allowed — post-create dd-4 assertion
13. t_config_keys_written_early_for_partial_state_recovery — iam_role_name BEFORE Lambda create; lambda_function_name BEFORE Function URL create; endpoint_url BEFORE concurrency
14. t_config_write_preserves_existing_keys
15. t_region_pinned_to_us_east_1

### Conventions
- chmod +x; set -euo pipefail; tests/lib/assert.sh helpers
- Use mktemp -d for DSO_CONFIG_FILE per test; trap cleanup
- ShellCheck-clean
- .test-index RED marker: `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh:tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh [t_happy_path_creates_all_resources]`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh && head -5 tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] All 15 test functions defined
  Verify: for fn in t_happy_path_creates_all_resources t_rerun_is_no_op t_missing_iam_aborts_before_create t_sts_get_caller_identity_failure_aborts_before_create t_missing_python_runtime_aborts_before_create t_missing_bucket_name_in_config_aborts_with_exit_6 t_iam_policy_scoped_to_bucket_arn_only t_iam_role_propagation_retry_with_backoff t_log_group_retention_7d t_function_url_no_api_gateway t_reserved_concurrency_set_to_10 t_simulate_principal_policy_returns_allowed t_config_keys_written_early_for_partial_state_recovery t_config_write_preserves_existing_keys t_region_pinned_to_us_east_1; do grep -qE "^${fn}\(\)|^function ${fn}" tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh || { echo "MISSING: $fn"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] DSO_AWS_CMD + DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD + DSO_CONFIG_FILE all referenced (test isolation contract)
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_AWS_CMD' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh && grep -q 'DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh && grep -q 'DSO_CONFIG_FILE' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] Test never writes to real .claude/dso-config.conf
  Verify: ! grep -nE '>>?\s*\.claude/dso-config\.conf|tee\s+.*\.claude/dso-config\.conf' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] No real AWS endpoints
  Verify: ! grep -q 'amazonaws\.com' tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for new test
  Verify: grep -qE 'aws-setup-lambda\.sh.*test-aws-setup-lambda\.sh \[' .test-index
- [ ] Pre-impl run fails RED
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
